questions.stem_text:
Of the following page-replacement policies, which is guaranteed to incur the minimum
number of page faults?

options.A: Replace the page whose next reference will be the longest time in the future.
options.B: Replace the page whose next reference will be the shortest time in the future.
options.C: Replace the page whose most recent reference was the shortest time in the past.
options.D: Replace the page whose most recent reference was the longest time in the past.

questions.answer_explanation: This page-replacement policy minimizes page faults by ensuring that the page replaced is the one that will not be needed for the longest period of time, thereby reducing the likelihood of immediate future accesses leading to faults.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following deals with network intrusion detection and real-time traffic
analysis?
questions.answer_explanation: Snort is an open-source network intrusion detection and prevention system that analyzes real-time traffic to detect and respond to malicious activities, making it the correct answer for the question.

questions.stem_text:
Failed sessions allow brute-force attacks on access credentials. This type of attacks are
done in which layer of the OSI model?
questions.answer_explanation: Brute-force attacks target the session layer of the OSI model because this layer is responsible for managing sessions between users and services, where failed sessions can indicate weaknesses that attackers exploit to gain unauthorized access to credentials.

questions.stem_text: Which form of encryption does WPA use?
questions.answer_explanation: WPA (Wi-Fi Protected Access) uses TKIP (Temporal Key Integrity Protocol) as a security protocol to provide improved data encryption and integrity for wireless networks, replacing the less secure WEP (Wired Equivalent Privacy).

questions.stem_text: Message authentication is primarily concerned with ensuring message confidentiality by encrypting the message content.
questions.answer_explanation: Message authentication is primarily concerned with verifying the integrity and authenticity of a message, rather than ensuring its confidentiality, which is the role of encryption.

questions.stem_text: The stack is utilized for storing global variables that can be accessed throughout the entire program.
questions.answer_explanation: The stack is primarily used for storing local variables and function call information, while global variables are stored in a separate memory area known as the data segment, making the statement false.

questions.stem_text: Insertion sort has average-case and worst-case time complexities of O(n log n).
questions.answer_explanation: Insertion sort has an average-case and worst-case time complexity of O(n^2), not O(n log n), because it requires nested iterations to compare and shift elements in the array, particularly in scenarios where the elements are in reverse order.

questions.stem_text: Wireless authentication between a user and an access point is typically completed through a method called AP-handshaking.
